title: FCC fines man behind election interference scheme $6 million for sending illegal robocalls that used deepfake generative AI technology
supports_claim: The FCC adopted a $6 million fine against Steve Kramer for illegal spoofed robocalls using an AI-generated clone of President Biden's voice to tell potential New Hampshire primary voters not to vote.
limitations: This is a specific U.S. telecommunications enforcement action; it does not estimate changed votes or establish duties for a Vietnamese text-summary prototype.

title: Investigation into the use of data analytics in political campaigns: a report to Parliament
supports_claim: The ICO reported an investigation into political data analytics involving political parties, platforms, data brokers, and analytics firms, and documented regulatory action arising from the investigation.
limitations: The historical UK investigation does not establish the effect of every targeted message on an individual voter or legal duties for CivicBrief.

title: Large Language Models Require Curated Context for Reliable Political Fact-Checking—Even with Reasoning and Web Search
supports_claim: An evaluation of 15 recent LLMs on more than 6,000 PolitiFact claims found that curated RAG improved macro-F1 by 233% on average; standard models performed poorly and web search made only moderate gains.
limitations: The study uses principally U.S. PolitiFact claims and does not test Vietnamese-language summaries, breaking news, belief, or sharing behavior.

title: Law No. 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: Vietnam published Law No. 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence, effective 2026-03-01.
limitations: The official publication alone does not classify CivicBrief or identify every applicable obligation without final intended-purpose and deployment facts.

title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689: Artificial Intelligence Act
publisher: Official Journal of the European Union
supports_claim: Article 50 addresses direct interaction with natural persons and AI-generated public-interest text, including a stated human-review, editorial-control, and editorial-responsibility condition for an exception to that text disclosure duty.
limitations: Applicability depends on final functions, deployment, target market, timing, and other EU law; it is not a legal opinion for CivicBrief.

title: Law No. 91/2025/QH15 on Personal Data Protection
supports_claim: Vietnam published Law No. 91/2025/QH15 on Personal Data Protection, effective 2026-01-01.
limitations: The official publication alone does not resolve CivicBrief's controller, processor, lawful-processing, retention, or transfer roles.

title: Decree No. 356/2025/ND-CP implementing the Personal Data Protection Law
supports_claim: Vietnam published Decree No. 356/2025/ND-CP to detail and implement the Personal Data Protection Law, effective 2026-01-01.
limitations: The decree must be reviewed against the final data flow and vendor arrangements; this row does not state that CivicBrief has met its requirements.

title: Decision No. 33/2026/QD-TTg issuing the list of high-risk AI systems
supports_claim: Vietnam issued Decision No. 33/2026/QD-TTg listing high-risk AI systems, effective 2026-08-15.
limitations: The list does not by itself establish that a fixed-corpus CivicBrief prototype is high-risk; legal review must assess its final intended purpose.

title: Decree No. 147/2024/ND-CP on management, provision, and use of internet services and online information
supports_claim: Vietnam published Decree No. 147/2024/ND-CP on management, provision, and use of internet services and online information, effective 2024-12-25.
limitations: The source title and publication do not determine CivicBrief's service classification or publication duties without legal review.

title: Decree No. 328/2026/ND-CP on prevention of fake and untrue information
supports_claim: Vietnam published Decree No. 328/2026/ND-CP on prevention of fake and untrue information; it takes effect 2026-10-05.
limitations: The decree takes effect after this pack's access date and must be interpreted by counsel for the final product and publication model.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports_claim: NIST AI RMF describes governance, mapping, measurement, and management activities, including documented roles, monitoring, and response for trustworthy AI risk management.
limitations: The voluntary framework is not a certification and does not prove that a control is effective.

title: Collision Between Vehicle Controlled by Developmental Automated Driving System and Pedestrian, Tempe, Arizona
supports_claim: The NTSB found the 2018 Tempe crash involved an ADS test vehicle and identified operator monitoring, safety-risk assessment, oversight, and automation complacency as contributing issues.
limitations: This report analyzes one US crash and does not establish performance of any future AV system or Vietnam pilot.

title: Dissecting racial bias in an algorithm used to manage the health of populations
supports_claim: The study found that a widely used health-management algorithm predicting cost rather than illness produced racial bias; changing the target would increase Black patients receiving additional help from 17.7% to 46.5%.
limitations: The study concerns a particular commercial algorithm and care-management context, not a conversational symptom-triage assistant or all populations.
